items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And I had met Harold before, like I said about 56, and Ernie Caglietti I think.

ctx.x: That's the first time I met him in 1956. I heard about him, seen him on the street and so forth. But at that time I was traveling on the road with different road bands, rhythm and blues bands at the time. Sherilyn Lee, Lil Walter, Jimmy Reed. We used to work out of a local office here in New Orleans, Stovall, Percy Stovall was involved in booking bands and so forth. And so naturally we went out on gigs, you know, from Shaw, a booking agency out of New York. Milt Shaw was the guy who was doing all the big time R&B…
And I had met Harold before, like I said about 56, and Ernie Caglietti I think.
